rules.description: The label contraindicates metformin when eGFR is below 30 mL/min/1.73m2.
rules.scope: Recorded renal contraindication check; no treatment-change instruction.

rules.description: The label discourages initiation in the 30–45 eGFR range and calls for benefit-risk review of existing therapy below 45.
rules.scope: At exactly 45 this demo conservatively requires review; recorded medication is not proof of current therapy.

rules.description: The label does not recommend empagliflozin for glycemic control when eGFR is below 30 mL/min/1.73m2.
rules.scope: Glycemic-control limitation only; not a general contraindication or an assessment of heart-failure/CKD indications.

rules.description: The Ozempic label contraindicates use with personal/family MTC history or MEN2.
rules.scope: Exact documented history statements only; absence of such a statement is UNKNOWN, not a negative screen.
